_comment: Base App / Farcaster Mini App manifest. __APP_URL__ is filled at build time from VITE_APP_URL (or the host URL on Vercel/Netlify). Base App discovery is handled via the base:app_id meta tag (index.html). accountAssociation is optional and only needed for native Farcaster/Warpcast verification — generate it with the Farcaster manifest tool for this domain and add it back here if you want that.

miniapp.name: Diamond Hands
miniapp.subtitle: Beat paper hands
miniapp.description: Lock your ERC-20 on-chain for a fixed term and beat paper hands. Soft mode with a decaying penalty, or hard lock.
